findings.principle: 反射型 XSS：输入经不完整的 script 黑名单正则替换后，未经 HTML 上下文编码直接拼入响应正文，攻击者可用事件属性标签（如 img/svg 的 onerror/onload）或嵌套标签重组绕过黑名单，使浏览器把输入解析为可执行标记。
findings.impact: 在已登录受害者的同源页面上下文中执行任意 JavaScript，可代表受害者发起请求、读取页面可见数据或篡改页面内容；教学验证仅使用 console.log 无害标记，不读取 Cookie、不外传数据。

poc.code: #!/usr/bin/env python3 '''XSS-003 reflected-XSS verification draft (harmless marker only). Sends one GET request to a local lab instance and prints the reflected region. A browser must still be opened manually to observe execution. ''' import argparse import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request ALLOWED_HOSTS = {'localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1'} class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler): def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl): return None def main() -> int: parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='XSS-003 local reflection check') parser.add_argument('--base', required=True, help='e.g. http://127.0.0.1/dvwa') parser.add_argument('--path', required=True, help='e.g. /vulnerabilities/xss_r/') parser.add_argument('--param', default='name') parser.add_argument( '--payload', default='', ) parser.add_argument('--cookie', default=None, help='optional PHPSESSID=... (never commit)') parser.add_argument('--security', default=None, help='optional DVWA security cookie value') parser.add_argument('--timeout', type=float, default=10.0) args = parser.parse_args() target = urllib.parse.urlsplit(args.base) if target.scheme not in ('http', 'https') or target.hostname not in ALLOWED_HOSTS: print('refusing non-local target', file=sys.stderr) return 2 url = args.base.rstrip('/') + args.path query = urllib.parse.urlencode({args.param: args.payload}) sep = '&' if '?' in url else '?' request = urllib.request.Request(url + sep + query, method='GET') request.add_header('User-Agent', 'xss003-lab-check/1.0') cookie = args.cookie if args.security: cookie = (cookie + '; ' if cookie else '') + 'security=' + args.security if cookie: request.add_header('Cookie', cookie) opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(request, timeout=args.timeout) as response: body = response.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace') print('status:', response.status) print('content-type:', response.headers.get('Content-Type')) except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc: print('http error:', exc.code, 'location:', exc.headers.get('Location'), file=sys.stderr) return 3 except urllib.error.URLError as exc: print('connection error:', exc.reason, file=sys.stderr) return 4 index = body.find(args.payload) if index == -1: print('marker not reflected verbatim; check login, security level and page path', file=sys.stderr) return 5 print('marker reflected at offset', index) print(body[max(0, index - 120):index + len(args.payload) + 120]) print('NOTE: reflection shown in HTTP only; browser execution needs manual observation.') return 0 if __name__ == '__main__': sys.exit(main())
